
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zlf2000/p/19075650" title="发布于 2025-09-05 16:35">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MySQL 字符串替换实战指南：2 个函数搞定 90% 业务需求</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">前言：为什么你需要这篇教程？</span></strong></h2>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">在日常开发</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">运维中，你是否遇到过这些场景：</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">电商系统需要批量替换商品详情中的旧域名（如从</span>http://old.com<span style="font-family: 等线">改成</span>https://new.com<span style="font-family: 等线">）；</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">用户表中手机号格式不统一，需在指定位置插入分隔符（如将</span>13800138000<span style="font-family: 等线">改成</span>138-0013-8000<span style="font-family: 等线">）；</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">日志数据中敏感字符需部分遮挡（如将</span>12345678901<span style="font-family: 等线">改成</span>123****8901<span style="font-family: 等线">）；</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">无需依赖</span> Python<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">PHP </span><span style="font-family: 等线">等外部脚本，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">MySQL </span><span style="font-family: 等线">自带的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">2 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个核心函数就能快速解决！本文手把手教你用</span>REPLACE()<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span>INSERT()<span style="font-family: 等线">实现高效字符串替换</span></p>
<h2><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">一、操作环境说明</span></strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">系统兼容</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Windows 7/10/11<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Linux</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">CentOS/Ubuntu</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">macOS</span></li>
<li><strong>MySQL <span style="font-family: 等线">版本</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>5.7/8.0/8.4<span style="font-family: 等线">（全版本支持，无兼容性问题）</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">适用终端</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Navicat<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">MySQL Workbench</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、命令行（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">CMD/SSH</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">硬件要求</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：无特殊配置，普通办公电脑</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">服务器均可运行</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">二、核心函数</span> 1<span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><span style="font-family: Arial">REPLACE ()—— </span><span style="font-family: 等线">全局批量替换</span></strong></h2>
<h3><strong>1. <span style="font-family: 等线">函数定位</span></strong></h3>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">适用于「全局替换某字符串中所有匹配的子串」，比如批量修改</span> URL<span style="font-family: 等线">、统一字段格式，执行效率高，支持结合</span>UPDATE<span style="font-family: 等线">批量操作表数据。</span></p>
<h3><strong>2. <span style="font-family: 等线">完整语法与参数解析</span></strong></h3>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">语法格式</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">REPLACE(string, from_string, new_string)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">参数</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">string</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，原始字符串</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">字段名（如表中的</span>path<span style="font-family: 等线">字段）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">from_string</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，需要被替换的子串（区分大小写！）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">new_string</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，用于替换的新子串（若为空则删除</span>from_string<span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3><strong>3. <span style="font-family: 等线">实战案例（含业务场景）</span></strong></h3>
<h4><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">案例</span> 1<span style="font-family: 等线">：基础字符串替换</span></strong></h4>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">需求：将测试字符串</span>aaa.mysql.com<span style="font-family: 等线">中的所有</span>a<span style="font-family: 等线">替换为</span>w</p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="100.0000%">
<p class="17">SELECT REPLACE('aaa.mysql.com', 'a', 'w') AS <span style="font-family: 等线">替换结果</span><span style="font-family: Arial">;</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="17"><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">执行结果</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">替换结果</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><a href="https://www.mysql.com/" rel="noopener nofollow">www.mysql.com</a></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h4><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">案例</span> 2<span style="font-family: 等线">：批量更新表数据（高频业务场景）</span></strong></h4>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">需求：某电商表</span>goods<span style="font-family: 等线">的</span>detail_url<span style="font-family: 等线">字段，需将所有</span>http://old-shop.com<span style="font-family: 等线">替换为</span>https://new-shop.com</p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="100.0000%">
<p class="17">-- <span style="font-family: 等线">先查询验证替换效果（避免误操作）</span></p>
<p class="17">SELECT detail_url, REPLACE(detail_url, 'http://old-shop.com', 'https://new-shop.com') AS <span style="font-family: 等线">新</span><span style="font-family: Arial">URL </span></p>
<p class="17">FROM goods LIMIT 10;</p>
<p class="17">-- <span style="font-family: 等线">确认无误后执行批量更新</span></p>
<p class="17">UPDATE goods</p>
<p class="17">SET detail_url = REPLACE(detail_url, 'http://old-shop.com', 'https://new-shop.com')</p>
<p class="17">-- <span style="font-family: 等线">可选：添加条件过滤，避免全表更新</span></p>
<p class="17">WHERE detail_url LIKE 'http://old-shop.com%';</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="17"><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">价值</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>1 <span style="font-family: 等线">行 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">SQL </span><span style="font-family: 等线">搞定 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">thousands </span><span style="font-family: 等线">条数据，无需手动修改，节省 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">1 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">小时 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">+ </span><span style="font-family: 等线">工时。</span></p>
<h3><strong>4. <span style="font-family: 等线">注意事项</span></strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">区分大小写：</span>REPLACE('MySQL', 'm', 'M')<span style="font-family: 等线">不会替换</span>MySQL<span style="font-family: 等线">中的</span>M<span style="font-family: 等线">（因小写</span>m<span style="font-family: 等线">不匹配）；</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">空值处理：若</span>from_string<span style="font-family: 等线">为空，返回原始字符串；若</span>new_string<span style="font-family: 等线">为空，会删除</span>from_string<span style="font-family: 等线">（如</span>REPLACE('abc123', '123', '')<span style="font-family: 等线">返回</span>abc<span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">三、核心函数</span> 2<span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><span style="font-family: Arial">INSERT ()—— </span><span style="font-family: 等线">指定位置精准替换</span></strong></h2>
<h3><strong>1. <span style="font-family: 等线">函数定位</span></strong></h3>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">适用于「在字符串指定位置插入</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">替换固定长度的子串」，比如修改编码格式、添加分隔符、部分字符遮挡，精准控制替换范围。</span></p>
<h3><strong>2. <span style="font-family: 等线">完整语法与参数解析</span></strong></h3>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">语法格式</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">INSERT(string, position, number, string2)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">参数</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">string</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，待修改的原始字符串</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">字段名</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">position</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，开始替换的位置（正数：从左数；负数</span> / 0<span style="font-family: 等线">：返回原始字符串）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">number</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，需要被替换的字符长度（超出原字符串长度则替换剩余所有字符）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">string2</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">必选，用于替换的新子串（若为</span> NULL <span style="font-family: 等线">则返回 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">NULL</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3><strong>3. <span style="font-family: 等线">实战案例（覆盖多场景）</span></strong></h3>
<h4><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">案例</span> 1<span style="font-family: 等线">：基础位置替换</span></strong></h4>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">需求：将</span>Football<span style="font-family: 等线">从第</span> 2 <span style="font-family: 等线">个字符开始，替换 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">4 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个字符为</span>Play</p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="100.0000%">
<p class="17">SELECT INSERT('Football', 2, 4, 'Play') AS <span style="font-family: 等线">替换结果</span><span style="font-family: Arial">;</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="17"><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">执行结果</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>FPlayall<span style="font-family: 等线">（原字符串</span>F+ <span style="font-family: 等线">新子串</span>Play+ <span style="font-family: 等线">剩余字符</span>all<span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></p>
<h4><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">案例</span> 2<span style="font-family: 等线">：特殊场景处理（位置超界 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">/ </span><span style="font-family: 等线">长度超界）</span></strong></h4>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="100.0000%">
<p class="17">SELECT</p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;&nbsp;-- <span style="font-family: 等线">场景</span><span style="font-family: Arial">1</span><span style="font-family: 等线">：开始位置为</span><span style="font-family: Arial">-1</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（超界，返回原字符串）</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT('Football', -1, 4, 'Play') AS <span style="font-family: 等线">位置超界</span><span style="font-family: Arial">,</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;&nbsp;-- <span style="font-family: 等线">场景</span><span style="font-family: Arial">2</span><span style="font-family: 等线">：替换长度</span><span style="font-family: Arial">20</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（超原字符串长度，替换剩余所有字符）</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;&nbsp;INSERT('Football', 3, 20, 'Play') AS <span style="font-family: 等线">长度超界</span><span style="font-family: Arial">;</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="17"><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">执行结果</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">位置超界</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">长度超界</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">Football</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">FoPlay</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h4><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">案例</span> 3<span style="font-family: 等线">：业务场景 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">—— </span><span style="font-family: 等线">手机号部分遮挡</span></strong></h4>
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">需求：将用户表</span>user<span style="font-family: 等线">中</span>phone<span style="font-family: 等线">字段的中间</span> 4 <span style="font-family: 等线">位替换为</span>****<span style="font-family: 等线">（如</span>13800138000→138****8000<span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="100.0000%">
<p class="17">UPDATE user</p>
<p class="17">SET phone = INSERT(phone, 4, 4, '****')</p>
<p class="17">WHERE phone REGEXP '^1[3-9][0-9]{9}$'; -- <span style="font-family: 等线">确保手机号格式正确</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="17"><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">价值</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：无需写复杂正则，</span>1 <span style="font-family: 等线">行 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">SQL </span><span style="font-family: 等线">实现敏感信息脱敏，符合数据安全规范。</span></p>
<h2><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">四、常见问题解答（</span>FAQ<span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></strong></h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>Q<span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><span style="font-family: Arial">REPLACE () </span><span style="font-family: 等线">替换不生效？</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<p class="17">A<span style="font-family: 等线">：检查是否区分大小写（如</span>replace('MySQL', 'mysql', 'xxx')<span style="font-family: 等线">因大小写不匹配无法替换），或</span>from_string<span style="font-family: 等线">存在空格</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">特殊字符（建议用</span>TRIM()<span style="font-family: 等线">先清理）。</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Q<span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><span style="font-family: Arial">INSERT () </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的位置参数怎么确定？</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<p class="17">A<span style="font-family: 等线">：从左数第 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">1 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个字符为位置 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">1</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（非 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">0</span><span style="font-family: 等线">），若需从末尾计算，可结合</span>LENGTH()<span style="font-family: 等线">函数（如</span>INSERT(str, LENGTH(str)-3, 3, '***')<span style="font-family: 等线">替换最后</span> 3 <span style="font-family: 等线">位）。</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Q<span style="font-family: 等线">：能否同时使用两个函数？</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<p class="17">A<span style="font-family: 等线">：可以！例如先全局替换再精准调整：</span></p>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="100.0000%">
<p class="17">SELECT INSERT(REPLACE('aaa.mysql.com', 'a', 'w'), 5, 5, 'sql8') AS <span style="font-family: 等线">组合结果</span><span style="font-family: Arial">;</span></p>
<p class="17">-- <span style="font-family: 等线">结果：</span><span style="font-family: Arial">www.sql8.com</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">五、总结：选择哪个函数？</span></strong></h2>
<p class="17">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">需求场景</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">推荐函数</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">优势</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">全局批量替换（如改域名）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">REPLACE()</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">效率高，支持批量更新</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">指定位置</span> / <span style="font-family: 等线">长度替换</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">INSERT()</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">精准控制，适合格式调整</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">敏感信息脱敏（如手机号）</span></p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17">INSERT()</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="184">
<p class="17"><span style="font-family: 等线">无需正则，操作简单</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="17"><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">立即行动</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：打开你的</span> MySQL <span style="font-family: 等线">终端，复制文中案例实操 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">10 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">分钟，就能掌握 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">90% </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的字符串替换需求！如果遇到特殊场景，欢迎在评论区留言，获取定制化解决方案～</span></p>
